script_text: Aries, stop scrolling — Neptune is quietly dissolving your edge right now. Your ruling planet Mars keeps stoking your Fire, but Neptune is parked in your 1st House of Identity while the Moon drops into Capricorn, your 10th House of Career, forming a hazy square that clouds judgment and blurs every deadline. Add the Sun in your 8th House trining Saturn in your 12th, and shared money, debts, and secrets demand slow, sober handling. In love, that same fog softens your 8th House of Intimacy: if you're taken, one unspoken resentment surfaces; if you're single, a mysterious, poetic type walks in by evening. Career-wise, generous Jupiter is trining your 4th House of Home, opening a remote-work, property, or family-money deal worth saying yes to. Avoid co-signing or lending anything important today, because this haze invites quiet financial loss. Follow for tomorrow's reading before the veil lifts.
